name: pr_branch_guard
description: Refuse a push if the PR branch tip has drifted since the feedback snapshot.

expectedHeadSha.description: SHA snapshot of the PR branch tip taken before edits; the guard fails validation (non-error) if this is blank.

repo.description: GitHub repository (owner/name or URL) that owns the branch, used to look up the current remote head.

branch.description: Remote branch name to compare against expectedHeadSha.

verificationState.description: 'matched' when the remote tip equals expectedHeadSha, 'branch_drift' when it changed, 'unknown' when the GitHub lookup itself failed.

expectedHeadSha.description: The expected head SHA supplied on input.

actualHeadSha.description: The remote branch tip SHA as observed now; empty string when the lookup failed.

reason.description: Present only when verificationState is 'unknown': the GitHub lookup failure detail.
